title: Google Play Store (TWA) publishing guidance + clarify supported authentication (Internet Identity)

requirements.text: Update the Google Play Store publishing documentation to provide a complete, step-by-step workflow for shipping the existing web app as an Android app using a Trusted Web Activity (Bubblewrap), including required Android build artifacts (package name, signing key guidance, app icon/manifest checks), Digital Asset Links verification, and Play Console release steps, using the production domain referenced in the repository documentation.

quotes: I want to publish it in Google play Store

acceptanceCriteria: The repository contains updated Play Store/TWA documentation that a developer can follow end-to-end to produce a signed Android App Bundle/APK for Play Console submission.
The documentation explicitly references the correct production web origin (custom domain) for TWA hosting and verification.
The documentation includes a checklist for required web/PWA assets (e.g., icons/manifest) and asset-links verification prerequisites.

requirements.text: Add an in-app “Authentication” help section/screen that clearly explains which login methods are supported in this Internet Computer app build (Internet Identity), and explicitly states that Firebase authentication options (Google, Microsoft/Outlook, phone OTP, and email/password) are not available in this platform environment.

quotes: with proper firebase login with Google, Outlook or via phone number options. Also if possible create sign up page for user id and password

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users can access a short help section that explains the supported sign-in method (Internet Identity) in clear English.
The help section explicitly mentions that Firebase-based login providers (Google, Microsoft/Outlook, phone number OTP, email/password) are not supported in this build environment.
No references to Firebase login buttons/options are added to the login flow; the existing Internet Identity login remains functional.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (immutable paths).
Firebase Authentication integration (Google/Microsoft/phone OTP/email-password) must not be implemented because third-party authentication is not supported; only Internet Identity is supported.
Do not introduce additional backend services or databases; backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.
nonGoals: Implementing Firebase SDK configuration, OAuth provider setup, or phone-number OTP flows.
Building a fully native Android app (the scope is TWA/Bubblewrap packaging of the existing web app).
Adding username/password credential storage or custom password authentication on the Motoko backend.
